headline: Gates Industrial Posts 5.6% Rise in Q3 Net Sales to $903.6 Million
summary: Gates Industrial reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $903.6 million, an increase of 5.6% year-over-year, alongside net income attributable to shareholders of $86.5 million, or $0.34 per diluted share.
why: Gates Industrial produces power transmission and fluid power solutions used across diverse automotive and industrial end-markets globally.

impacts.name: Gates Industrial
impacts.why: Reported 5.6% top-line sales growth and positive net income of $86.5 million for Q3.
